{{Quote|This is an Imperial News Network travel ban update. The planet Tatooine remains the site of a major rakghoul plague outbreak.|Unidentified Imperial announcer by holoprojector broadcast|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial News Network''' was a state news broadcasting organization under the [[Ministry of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Ministry of Intelligence]] operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
{{Quote|If you encounter evidence of a rakghoul plague outbreak, report it immediately to the nearest Imperial military station. Failure to comply is considered treason. This has been an Imperial News Network special bulletin.|Unidentified Imperial announcer by audio broadcast|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Operating around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Imperial News Network provided news updates to citizens of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] by video at [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] sites at locations such as [[Vaiken Spacedock]] or by audio-only announcements at Sith facilities.

The news service was operated by the [[Ministry of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Ministry of Intelligence]] and provided coverage on the outbreak of [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], informing travelers of known quarantine sites and reminding them of their duties as Imperial citizens to help contain the plague.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
